method.target: Within-decision-centered legal settlement logit, not win probability.
method.fitting: Separate fits by stage. Each training board has equal weight and candidates share its weight. Training-RMS standardized ridge alpha=0.001; exact dependencies omitted in feature order.
method.coefficients: Raw logit units per feature unit; all five base resource coefficients share pip units.
method.coefficient_uncertainty: Board-cluster sandwich around the fixed-ridge estimand, including empirical RMS scaling; retained feature set held fixed. Normal 95% intervals.
method.test_uncertainty: Whole-board delta-method intervals for held-out R² and paired ΔR²; conditional on fitted coefficients.
method.enrichment: Ratio of board-equal mean chosen resource fraction to mean baseline fraction, across all generated boards. Log-ratio delta-method intervals, paired by board. Not mean of per-board ratios.
method.baseline: Uniformly random currently legal positive-production corner. Zero-pip corners excluded only from this descriptive resource-share baseline.
method.matched_baseline: Uniform among legal corners with the chosen corner's exact total pips and adjacent-hex count (coastal geometry), including the chosen corner; report only boards with at least 3 matching corners.
method.board_scarcity: P_r(candidate) × (58 × tile_count_r / 18 − total_board_resource_pips_r). Positive coefficient associates lower supply with greater per-pip priority.
method.legal_scarcity: P_r(candidate) × (58 × tile_count_r / 162 − mean_legal_corner_resource_pips_r). Separate alternative model; at A1 exactly board_scarcity/9.
method.scarcity_multiple_comparisons: Also report Bonferroni intervals for the 40 resource×stage×availability-measure coefficients; A1 measures are equivalent, so this is conservative.
method.resource_context: Full original context plus each resource's candidate-pip interactions with owned pips, missing access, owned matching 2:1 port, geometric port proximity; resource-specific direct ports and starting cards.

limitations: Frozen Generation 37 network preferences under one greedy opening trajectory per random board; no search, full-game outcomes, or causal intervention.
Generator-distribution conclusions; later-stage histories are conditional on preceding greedy choices, not representative of all human openings.
More boards reduce sampling uncertainty, not confounding, model misspecification, policy bias, or dependence on the trained checkpoint.
Matched baselines condition on chosen total production and geometry, and cover an explicitly reported subset.
Scarcity regressions describe conditional associations, not causal resource values. Board supply and legal availability are correlated; they are fitted separately.
Intervals condition on the analysis specification and model training; no uncertainty over independently trained policies is included.
